cases.title: a5: When do we have the most traffic during the day, and is it consistent?
cases.input: When do we have the most traffic during the day, and is it consistent?

trials.output: Peak traffic occurs during daytime business hours from 06:00 to 20:00 (Europe/Zurich time), averaging around 430 events per hour [1]. The busiest hours are 10:00 (averaging 446 events) and 18:00 (averaging 443 events), though hour 10 and hour 18 alternate as the peak on different days, showing the pattern is generally consistent day to day [1]. Traffic drops significantly at night, falling to around 215 events per hour between 21:00 and 05:00 [1].
